# Labcorp is planning to expand its digital pathology capabilities across its network


29 Sep 2026


## Labcorp expands digital pathology capabilities across its network


As digital pathology continues to transform diagnostic medicine, Mahul Amin, MD, vice president and medical director of digital pathology and hospital systems at Labcorp, discusses how the organization is building a standardized, scalable digital pathology program across its network of anatomic pathology laboratories. The interview explores Labcorp's approach to integrating digital pathology, cloud-based image management, and artificial intelligence to enhance efficiency, support subspecialty expertise, and advance patient care. Dr. Amin also shares insights into the future role of AI in pathology workflows and how digital pathology is creating new opportunities for health systems and hospital partnerships.


## Read the full interview with Dr. Amin to learn how Labcorp is leveraging digital pathology and AI to help shape the future of diagnostic pathology.
